evidence_class: simulation (sim_bench_hr ideal plant, 1 kHz; mpc: sim_bench); the certificate rows are evaluations of the float evaluator certify_fb.evaluate (certificate, informative); the rows of the previous round are copied from its record (simulation, not rerun)

design.reference: head: shaped reference a_r of design_fb.json on [0, T_xi), -a_b until v_r = 0; followers: constants only, desired clearance d_s,i from takeover (sim_bench_hr on a shaped setup)

mpc_port.substituted: s0 of the sim_bench inputs := s0 of sim_bench_hr.setup (takeover positions); every other input unchanged
mpc_port.reason: certify_plan.shaped_plan keeps the parking gaps in the planned positions (s0 = takeover_positions(d_s, d_s[1:])); sim_bench.setup uses the planned positions as the initial state; sim_bench_hr.setup (sim_hr.hr_setup) places the units at the clearances c0 with the head at its slot

mpc.information: absolute position and speed of the unit; head: planned position and speed of unit 1 (the HR reference minus the head slot); follower: predicted trajectory of the predecessor over the horizon, received one control period (0.1 s) late; filter: received applied command of the predecessor; no follower plans, no schedules
mpc.t_nonneg_note: from the record at every step (ideal plant)

mpc.information: absolute position and speed of the unit; head: planned position and speed of unit 1 (the HR reference minus the head slot); follower: predicted trajectory of the predecessor over the horizon, received one control period (0.1 s) late; filter: received applied command of the predecessor; no follower plans, no schedules
mpc.t_nonneg_note: from the record at every step (ideal plant)

certificates.note: float evaluator certify_fb.evaluate at the design age bound; informative (the dispatcher of the FB design re-runs the design rule for another takeover state; here the reference is kept fixed)

previous_round.label: stored-schedule design of the previous round (followers store gap-closing schedules started by a relayed closure flag): outside the information model of the FB design; reference only; numbers copied from its record, not rerun
previous_round.not_comparable: other design: gain 0.15, T_xi 86.142 s, parking gaps 5 m (head slot 6 m); T_f and clearance margins are not comparable with the FB rows

columns.disp: stopping-time dispersion, last stop minus first stop [s] (None: not every unit stopped, or contact)
columns.marker: largest |marker error| [m] (markers: planned stop positions of the run's own reference)
columns.gap: largest |terminal gap error| [m] (to the parking gaps)
columns.gmin: smallest clearance margin g_i = c_i - s_m over the run and the pairs [m] (intersample minimum)
columns.u_abs_max: largest |applied net command| before the latch [m/s^2]
columns.u_max: largest applied net command [m/s^2] (0: the zero command held by follower i before its first delivery, (i-1) x 19 ms)
columns.atU: time with the applied command at the traction limit U, worst unit [s]
columns.nonneg: time with the applied command at 0 or above, worst unit [s] (includes the startup of follower i, (i-1) x 19 ms)
columns.pos: time with the applied command above 0, worst unit [s] (record at every 1 ms step, ideal plant)
columns.nom_above_U: time with u_nom > U, worst unit [s]
columns.clipU: time in which the input set clipped the filter output at U, worst unit [s]
columns.barrier: time in which the filter lowered the applied command (fallback included), worst unit [s]
columns.fallback: time with u_cbf < -U_i^- (fallback -U_i^-), summed over the followers [s]
columns.in_box_at_Txi: every pair error in the handoff box (eps_e, eps_v) at T_xi
columns.stop_order: units in the order of their stops
columns.met: every unit stopped, no contact, dispersion <= 1 s, markers <= 3 m, gaps <= 1 m
